title: The maximum Laplacian ratio of a tree: a complete answer to a question of Brualdi and Goldwasser, kernel-checked in Lean
description: Lean 4 formalization, certificate generators and paper answering a question of Brualdi and Goldwasser (1984): for every n >= 4 the tree maximizing per L(T)/prod deg(v) is an explicit spider of cherry arms, and the maximum grows exactly like ((621/64)^(1/11))^n. Kernel-checked in Lean 4 with Mathlib; standard axioms only. The maximum and the maximizer were independently re-checked by a second kernel (nanoda, via the Lean FRO's Comparator). v1.3.0 adds: the maximizer is unique up to isomorphism for every n >= 4 except n = 21, where exactly T(3,3,3) and S(21,10) are maximal (formalization/BGUnique, checked by Lean's kernel; Comparator confirms the challenge statement); and, for the weighted family pi_lambda, part (B) of the uniform theorem with its equality clause for every 0 < lambda < 1+sqrt(5) (formalization/cherry). v1.4.0 adds computations/: the programs behind every computer-verified step of the accompanying paper and its supplement, each with a README and expected output, second implementations where available, and negative controls. Not yet refereed.
